$comment: Share images and social posts, from the brand's own social tool in agd-playground (src/components/hoplite-og: draw.ts layoutFor and drawDesign, scene.ts, content.ts; route /hoplite). Each template is the tool's layout, ported as is (src/assets/og.ts): the measure, the dashed rules, the notes, the globe, cube and loader, the lockup and the foot line. Colors are token names; an opacity beside a token is the tool's own (its drawings set the ink at 40 to 72 percent). Copy is the tool's sample copy for the occasion each template borrows, without third-party names.

light.label: Light
light.description: The site's warm ground and ink (the default, as on hoplite.sh).

night.label: Night
night.description: The site's dark theme: the ink and the ground swapped (the tool's default look).

black.label: Black
black.description: The darkest ground the dark theme has (bg-dark), the tool's Black.

notes: Theme Night: the tool's ground #1d1d1d is the dark theme's ground (#1A1A1A); its ink #f0f0ee is the dark ink (#F2F2F0); its gray #8d8d89 is the dark text-muted (#929291).
Theme Black: the tool's #0d0d0d is the dark theme's bg-dark (#0F0F0F).

Theme Light: the tool's #eaeaea ground and #121212 ink are the site's ground (#F2F2F0) and ink (#1A1A1A); its gray #6b6b68 is text-muted (#626261). Light is the default here because the site is light by default; the tool opens on Night.
The tool's Red theme (an orange ground) is left out: the brand's principles keep the orange a mark, never a fill for a whole panel.

Faces: the tool set notes and the foot line in Share Tech Mono and its text in Chakra Petch; tokens.css names Kode Mono for labels, so notes, the loader and the foot are Kode Mono. Headlines stay Chakra Petch light, as both set them.
The cog node and the lockup's horse are the orange, as in the tool and the app icon.

A picture (--image) takes the drawing's place, cropped to fill the drawing's box inside the rules, framed with the site's corner ticks (.ds-corners, 16px). --shade darkens it with bg-dark, as the tool's window shade darkens the brand's aerials.
The film grain is raster only: an SVG leaves it out so the file stays vector.
The tool's foot line read BACKED BY Y COMBINATOR; a third-party name is not shipped, so the foot's right side is the brand's tagline. Pass --foot-right to change it.

globe.label: Globe
globe.description: The headline top left inside the dashed rules, a note under it at each side, the globe's top rising to the rule at the foot, the lockup bottom right.

copy.headline: Everything a swarm of agents needs.
copy.note: An orchestrator plans the work, runs subagents in parallel and checks what comes back.
copy.note2: Every agent gets its own branch and its own sandbox.

cube.label: Cube
cube.description: The headline top left, two notes down the left, a cube cut into cells running off the right edge and the foot, the lockup bottom right.

copy.headline: Bring your own skills and MCP servers.
copy.note: Drive Hoplite from any MCP client through api.hoplite.sh/mcp.
copy.note2: Approve sensitive actions when they come up.

horizon.label: Horizon
horizon.description: The headline centered, a globe's dome under it with a ring and a large node on its pole, the address and a line at the foot.

copy.headline: A workstation for your army of coding agents.

banner.label: Header
banner.description: A globe at the left, the headline and a note at the right, one dashed rule along the foot (on tall frames the globe sits above the words).

copy.headline: A workstation for your army of coding agents.
copy.note: Agents run in the cloud and let you know when they need input.

loader.label: Loader
loader.description: The headline top left, a note, and the loading bar with its node across the image, the lockup bottom right.

copy.headline: Hoplite is almost out of beta.
copy.note: Thousands of threads run on Hoplite every day.

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: The lockup large in the middle over the dome, the address and a line at the foot.

partner.label: Lockup
partner.description: The lockup beside a partner's name (or logo, --partner) with a cross between them, the headline under it, the dome below and the foot line.
